brief:
Israeli air strikes on Gaza killed 10 Palestinians in two separate attacks, Al Jazeera English reported. One strike targeted a police headquarters while another hit a refugee camp, both densely populated civilian areas where the fatalities occurred during ongoing military operations across the territory.

Hamas swiftly condemned the strikes, characterizing them as a "new war crime" in a statement responding to the attacks. The militant faction's denunciation marked another escalation in rhetoric as Israeli military operations continued throughout Gaza.
dek: Israeli air strikes on Gaza kill 10 Palestinians, targeting police headquarters and a refugee camp in separate attacks.
title: Israel kills 10 Palestinians in Gaza strikes on police, camp
